query: Duisburg Germany Uber taxi fare per km base fare 2026
snippet: Duisburg taxi fares: base fare 4.5 EUR, per km rate 2.0 EUR. Since September 1, 2025, passengers in Duisburg can book taxi rides at a fixed price via the Freenow app; fixed-price options introduced via municipal taxi fare schedule adjustments and platform providers such as Freenow or Uber.
